correctness.rationale: The fixed space of any simplicial H-action is represented by admissible full vertex-orbits, by constant barycentric coordinates; the inverse rescales orbit weights. S6 has 720 permutations; the inspected checker generates all subgroups by adjoining elements up to conjugacy, validates class sizes by normalizers and reports 56 classes/1455 labeled subgroups. The actual CSV provides all 56 collapse sequences and residual face sets, each pair required to be a codimension-one free face of a unique maximal simplex. The trivial group has 15 vertices, 45 edges, 15 faces and a connected graph residual with 15 vertices and 30 edges (16 loops). Nontrivial residuals are empty, one vertex or three vertices: labeled counts 234,1140,80. Independent small subgroup-orbit check confirms separate disjoint 3-cycle groups have three admissible orbit vertices each but their joint order-nine group has none. These are finite exhaustive certificates; potential code error remains.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general H model covers the mathematical model and makes this finite answer computable, but leaves 56 nontrivial collapse classifications and labeled counts unproved; it is a priority/coverage risk rather than automatically a known table.
